B: The panel is a parasagittal SPECT image showing juxtacortical ossification and prominent tracer uptake in the left proximal humerus, which is diagnostic for voriconazole-induced periostitis as part of a multi-site presentation. C: This panel shows a SPECT image of a rib demonstrating juxtacortical ossification and tracer uptake, a specific presentation of voriconazole-induced periostitis. D: The panel is an axial SPECT image showing juxtacortical ossification at the clavicles bilaterally, correlating with the diagnosis of voriconazole-induced periostitis.
